key_phrases: Demand remained exceptionally strong, outpacing supply
RTX technology has reset computer graphics
Revenue of $6.5 billion and year-on-year growth of 68%
Supply constraint in our gaming business
Omniverse is an overlay of the physical world
analysis.reasoning: The company reported record-breaking revenue and massive YoY growth across key segments (Gaming, Data Center, Pro Viz). Management demonstrated extremely high confidence in their technological moat (RTX, CUDA, Omniverse) and demand strength, explicitly stating that demand is outpacing supply. While there are clear supply chain constraints and regulatory risks regarding the Arm acquisition, the overall tone was highly optimistic with very specific quantitative data provided. The QA session was direct, with management addressing difficult questions about crypto-mining impact (LHR strategy) and software monetization models without evasion.
